name: Pension Steiner
beschreibung:
Overview

The Ferienpension Steiner is situated at around 1,236 metres above sea level on the sunny mid-mountain plateau of Weerberg in the Silberregion Karwendel. The family-run establishment offers comfortable holiday rooms with breakfast as well as cosy holiday apartments – either with breakfast or self-catering. From the private balconies guests enjoy the view over the Inntal valley and the Karwendel mountains. Directly next to the house is the Hüttegglift, which makes getting started on winter fun particularly convenient. The quiet, natural location is the starting point for alpine pasture and forest hikes as well as eventful mountain tours. All rooms and apartments are equipped with a double bed (extra bed or baby cot on request), bathroom with bathtub or shower and WC, cosy seating area, large satellite TV, free high-speed internet throughout the house and a private balcony; a mini kitchen is available for the shared use of room guests.

History/Background

The Ferienpension Steiner was built in 1981 by Johann Steiner sen. and his wife Elisabeth with great dedication and opened four years later. Since 1996 the house has been run by their son Hans Steiner and his wife Margret as a family business in the second generation. Since 2024 the eldest daughter has managed the guesthouse together with the whole family in the third generation – with lived tradition and Tyrolean hospitality.

Getting there

According to the operator, the easiest way to reach the guesthouse is by car, as there is no bus stop near the house. In Weerberg, drive towards the church, pass it and after about 1,000 metres follow the turn-off to the left; at the “Zirler” bus stop a signpost points to the house, from here it is still around 2.5 kilometres. The well-built mountain road leads through several bends – for the last kilometres you should allow a little more driving time. In winter, winter equipment is absolutely essential. By train, travel to Schwaz or Jenbach and from there by bus to Weerberg to the “Zirler” bus stop (approx. 2.5 km away) or quite comfortably by taxi to the front door; at the weekend the scheduled buses do not run regularly. From Innsbruck Airport, take a taxi to the guesthouse.

Tips

The holiday day begins with a balanced breakfast buffet of homemade, regional products in the breakfast room or in the newly renovated stove room, daily from 7:30 to 9:30 a.m. In the summer season there is a small snack menu, in the winter season, by arrangement, a 3-course half-board menu. Check-in is from 2:00 to 7:00 p.m., check-out from 6:00 to 9:30 a.m.; for arrivals after 7 p.m. the establishment asks for a short notification. Pets are not allowed. For children there is a children's bonus, a baby cot and further baby equipment are provided free of charge on request; in bad weather there is a playroom next to the breakfast room, in good weather a small children's playground with trampoline, slide, sandpit, swings as well as rabbits and guinea pigs is available. Free parking is available; prices are exclusive of the statutory local tax (currently € 2.60 per person per night).

Best time to visit

The guesthouse is open both in winter and in summer. In the cold season the Hüttegglift is right next to the house, the Kellerjoch ski area around 30 minutes' drive away; in summer around 1,000 km of hiking trails of the Silberregion Karwendel as well as the Weißlahn swimming lake, about 15 minutes' drive away, are enticing. Those who are flexible enjoy the quiet mountain location in both seasons.
